content.query:
PRODUCT_TYPE='UD013' AND  BANK_CODE='CBC01'  AND  SOURCE_CODE='LNS' (UPDATED) .
PRODUCT_TYPE='32005' AND  BANK_CODE='CBC01'  AND  SOURCE_CODE='DEP' (DELETED) . 
PRODUCT_TYPE='00013' AND  BANK_CODE='CBC01'  AND  SOURCE_CODE='DEP'  (UNCHANGED) .
PRODUCT_TYPE='9999' AND  BANK_CODE='CBC01'  AND  SOURCE_CODE='LN' (NEW RECORD) . 

select PRODUCT_TYPE PRODUCT_TYPE2,SCD_START_DATE SCD_START_DATE_2, SCD_END_DATE SCD_END_DATE_2,* from (
SELECT PRODUCT_TYPE PRODUCT_TYPE2,NIM_FPAD NIM_FPAD2, * FROM
EDS.DID_PRODUCTGROUPING WHERE PRODUCT_TYPE='UD013' AND  BANK_CODE='CBC01'  AND  SOURCE_CODE='LNS' AND SCD_START_DATE>='20240830' 
UNION ALL
SELECT PRODUCT_TYPE PRODUCT_TYPE2,NIM_FPAD NIM_FPAD2, * FROM
EDS.DID_PRODUCTGROUPING WHERE PRODUCT_TYPE='32005' AND  BANK_CODE='CBC01'  AND  SOURCE_CODE='DEP' AND SCD_START_DATE>='20240830'  
UNION ALL
SELECT PRODUCT_TYPE PRODUCT_TYPE2,NIM_FPAD NIM_FPAD2, * FROM
EDS.DID_PRODUCTGROUPING WHERE PRODUCT_TYPE='00013' AND  BANK_CODE='CBC01'  AND  SOURCE_CODE='DEP'  AND SCD_START_DATE>='20240830'  
UNION ALL
SELECT PRODUCT_TYPE PRODUCT_TYPE2,NIM_FPAD NIM_FPAD2, * FROM
EDS.DID_PRODUCTGROUPING WHERE PRODUCT_TYPE='9999' AND  BANK_CODE='CBC01'  AND  SOURCE_CODE='LNS' AND SCD_START_DATE>='20240830'  ) temp order by PRODUCT_TYPE, SCD_START_DATE
